Event_Name: Vaccines: The Frontline of Preventive Care
Event_Description: Join us to learn how immunization protects both individuals and communities from serious infectious diseases by strengthening the body’s natural defenses. We will discuss the basics of how vaccines work, why they are essential for preventing illness throughout every stage of life, and how herd immunity helps safeguard public health—especially for those who are most vulnerable.  We will also share common misconceptions about vaccines and highlight the importance of staying up to date with recommended vaccinations to support lifelong health and disease prevention. There will be opportunity for Q&A with Dr. Pozner.
Additional_Info: This is a virtual presentation open to all.
